SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT USER_ID, BUYER FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT(BUYER) FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'BING' AND OK_FLAG = 'Y') AND USE_FLAG = 'T' AND ROWNUM = 1 GROUP BY USER_ID, BUYER
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT '000' AS HOUSE_CODE , '1000' AS COMPANY_CODE , 'PR' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHHMISS') AS PR_NUMBER , LPAD(ROWNUM,'3','0') AS PR_SEQ , CART.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATERIAL_NUMBER , BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION_LOC , DECODE(CART.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(CART.CART_QTY,1)) AS PR_QTY , CQDT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE , CQDT.CUR AS CUR , DECODE(BYIT.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(CART.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(CQDT.TARGET_PRICE,0)) AS UNIT_PRICE , DECODE(BYIT.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(CART.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(CQDT.TARGET_PRICE,0))*DECODE(CART.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(CART.CART_QTY,1)) AS PR_AMT , ' ' AS RD_DATE , CART.REMARK AS REMARK , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CART.USER_ID) > 1 THEN MAX(BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC) OVER (PARTITION BY CART.USER_ID) || ' . ' || TO_NUMBER( (COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CART.USER_ID) )-1 ) || '.' ELSE MAX(BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC) OVER (PARTITION BY CART.USER_ID) END AS SUBJECT , 'N' AS DEL_FLAG , (SELECT T.LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR T WHERE T.USER_ID = CART.USER_ID) AS PR_USER_ID , (SELECT B.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR B WHERE B.USER_ID = CART.USER_ID) AS PR_USER_NAME , 'KP' AS CREATE_TYPE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , (SELECT T.LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR T WHERE T.USER_ID = CART.USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID , '001' AS PR_TYPE , 'T' AS SIGN_STATUS , 'T' AS PR_STATUS , SUM(DECODE(BYIT.FIXED_PRICE_FLAG,'N',NVL(CART.UNIT_PRICE,0),NVL(CQDT.TARGET_PRICE,0))*DECODE(CART.CART_QTY,'0','1',NVL(CART.CART_QTY,1))) OVER (PARTITION BY CART.USER_ID) AS PR_TOT_AMT FROM ICOMCART CART, ICOMBYIT BYIT, ICOMCQDT CQDT WHERE 1=1 AND CART.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CART.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = BYIT.BUYER
AND BYIT.BUYER = CQDT.BUYER
AND CART.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CART.CONTRACT_NO = CQDT.CONTRACT_NO AND CART.CONTRACT_SEQ = CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ AND CART.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND CART.USER_ID = '$G_RS.USER_ID$' AND CART.USE_FLAG = 'T' ORDER BY PR_SEQ
DELETE FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND USER_ID = '$G_RS.USER_ID$' AND USE_FLAG = 'T'
UPDATE ICOMCART SET USE_FLAG = 'C' WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND USER_ID = '$G_RS.USER_ID$' AND USE_FLAG = 'T'
